verdict.rationale: Snyk documents applying fixes, not just reporting findings: the Remediation Agent generates a fix plan, applies the fixes and verifies the result, via `snyk fix --agentic` in the CLI or `/snyk-fix` and `/snyk-batch-fix` in coding assistants. DeepCode AI is marketed as powering 85%-accurate security autofixes, and Snyk Open Source supports fixes through pull requests. Community comments complain about noisy dependency-update PRs, which concerns fix quality rather than showing the capability is absent. Missing for 10: detailed docs on in-IDE one-click autofix for Snyk Code SAST findings, and independent hands-on corroboration of code-level autofix accuracy.
